**Archived issue-862-memory-lane: verify PASS, section 5 ticked, change dir moved to openspec/changes/archive/862**

**What**: On 2026-09-09 the #862 ruling change was closed. Native `gentle-ai sdd-status` routed apply → verify → archive (three pending tasks 5.1–5.3). Ticked 5.1–5.3 with evidence (PR #891 two APPROVE rounds, merged a14ff426; #892 → PR #893 two APPROVE rounds, merged 2c2105a6). sdd-verify (sonnet) wrote verify-report.md: PASS, 0 CRITICAL, 0 WARNING, 1 SUGGESTION (gh shows the bot's verdict as COMMENTED). `npm run brain:change:archive -- issue-862-memory-lane` moved the folder to openspec/changes/archive/862/ (no delta specs to consolidate). Commit 1eef1731 on branch docs/issue-862-archive (worktree brain-issue-862-archive), archive PR opened with Closes #862 against the closed issue (the #735/#709 precedent), type:docs.

**Why**: closes the SDD cycle of the Wave 1 ruling before Wave 3 (#886–#890) starts.

**Where**: openspec/changes/archive/862/**; engram topic keys sdd/issue-862-memory-lane/{ruling,spec,design,tasks,apply-progress,pr,promotion-sitting,verify-report,archive-report}.

**Learned**: the archive verb's single-change path never consults the VCS; it prints "specs delta fusionado" even when the change declares no capability (nothing under openspec/specs changed). An archive PR against an already-closed issue passes issue-link (status:approved label still present).
